effect.the_beyond.weightless.description: Reduces your gravity. Also resets your fall distance.
effect.the_beyond.nomads_blessing.descri: Granted by the mysterious Abyssal Nomad upon giving it a Rememberance. Saves you from falling into void, but only in the End.
effect.the_beyond.deafened.description: You can't hear anything - not even the game menu sounds. Creepy!
